paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: Error distribution in Audio-Reasoner.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error types observed during a benchmark evaluation. There are six slices representing different categories of errors: “Perceptual Error” (37%), “Reasoning Error” (20%), “Correct Answer but Wrong Choice” (15%), “Repeat Thinking and No Answer” (12%), “Choice Format Error” (4%), and “Wrong Understanding Error” (3%). The slices are colored in shades of blue, with percentage labels displayed within each segment. A legend is not included, and the slices appear to be arranged in a generally descending order of size, starting from “Perceptual Error”.
